title: OP SCRIPT BEST
features: OP SCRIPT OPEN SOURCE MADE BY AI
script:
-- LocalScript 

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

-- ================= CONFIG =================
local delayTime = 0
local autorizado = true
local runningMoneybag = false
local runningPotion = false
local runningFarm = false

local farmPos = Vector3.new(902.13, 460.02, -20.18)
local FARM_PROMPT_NAME = "ProximityPrompt"

local buyEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("BuyToolEvent")
local gravityEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ClaimGravityCoil")

-- ================= IDIOMAS =================
local language = "PT"

local texts = {
	PT = {
		title = "🔥 OP CREDITO LOWPROFILE 🔥",
		money = "Moneybag",
		potion = "Potion",
		drop = "Dropar Todos",
		farm = "Farm",
		gravity = "Gravity Coil [PEGADO]",
		gravityDefault = "Gravity Coil",
		lang = "🌐 Idioma: PT"
	},
	EN = {
		title = "🔥 OP CREDIT LOWPROFILE 🔥",
		money = "Moneybag",
		potion = "Potion",
		drop = "Drop All",
		farm = "Farm",
		gravity = "Gravity Coil [CLAIMED]",
		gravityDefault = "Gravity Coil",
		lang = "🌐 Language: EN"
	}
}

-- ================= FUNÇÕES =================
local function notifyFarm()
	pcall(function()
		StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
			Title = "Auto Farm",
			Text = "Clique para coletar o baú",
			Duration = 5
		})
	end)
end

local function dropAllWithEquip()
	local backpack = player:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
	local char = player.Character
	if not char then return end

	if backpack then
		for _, item in ipairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
			if item:IsA("Tool") then
				item.Parent = char
			end
		end
	end

	for _, item in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
		if item:IsA("Tool") then
			item.Parent = workspace
		end
	end
end

-- ================= AUTOBUY =================
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		if autorizado and runningMoneybag then
			pcall(function()
				buyEvent:FireServer("Moneybag", 0)
			end)
		end
		task.wait(delayTime)
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		if autorizado and runningPotion then
			pcall(function()
				buyEvent:FireServer("Body Swap Potion", 0)
			end)
		end
		task.wait(delayTime)
	end
end)

-- ================= AUTO FARM =================
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		if autorizado and runningFarm then
			local char = player.Character
			local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

			if hrp then
				hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(farmPos)

				for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
					if obj:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and obj.Name == FARM_PROMPT_NAME and obj.Enabled then
						local parent = obj.Parent
						if parent and parent:IsA("BasePart") then
							if (parent.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude <= 12 then
								fireproximityprompt(obj, 4)
								break
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
			task.wait(0.4)
		else
			task.wait(0.2)
		end
	end
end)

-- ================= GUI =================
local autoGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", player.PlayerGui)
autoGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

local autoFrame = Instance.new("Frame", autoGui)
autoFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0,370,0,380)
autoFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5,-185,0.5,-190)
autoFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25,25,25)
autoFrame.Active = true
autoFrame.Draggable = true

Instance.new("UICorner", autoFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,12)
local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", autoFrame)
stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,0,0)
stroke.Thickness = 2

local autoTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel", autoFrame)
autoTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,45)
autoTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
autoTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
autoTitle.TextSize = 26
autoTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,80,80)

local function makeButton(text,y)
	local b = Instance.new("TextButton", autoFrame)
	b.Size = UDim2.new(0,300,0,40)
	b.Position = UDim2.new(0.5,-150,0,y)
	b.Text = text
	b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	b.TextScaled = true
	b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
	b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180,0,0)
	Instance.new("UICorner", b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,10)
	return b
end

local moneyBtn = makeButton("",60)
local potionBtn = makeButton("",105)
local dropBtn = makeButton("",150)
local farmBtn = makeButton("",195)
local gravityBtn = makeButton("",240)
local langBtn = makeButton("",285)

-- ================= ATUALIZAR TEXTO =================
local function updateLanguage()
	autoTitle.Text = texts[language].title
	moneyBtn.Text = texts[language].money .. (runningMoneybag and " [ON]" or " [OFF]")
	potionBtn.Text = texts[language].potion .. (runningPotion and " [ON]" or " [OFF]")
	farmBtn.Text = texts[language].farm .. (runningFarm and " [ON]" or " [OFF]")
	dropBtn.Text = texts[language].drop
	langBtn.Text = texts[language].lang

	if gravityBtn.BackgroundColor3 == Color3.fromRGB(0,170,0) then
		gravityBtn.Text = texts[language].gravity
	else
		gravityBtn.Text = texts[language].gravityDefault
	end
end

updateLanguage()

-- ================= BOTÕES =================
moneyBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
	runningMoneybag = not runningMoneybag
	updateLanguage()
	moneyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = runningMoneybag and Color3.fromRGB(0,170,0) or Color3.fromRGB(180,0,0)
end)

potionBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
	runningPotion = not runningPotion
	updateLanguage()
	potionBtn.BackgroundColor3 = runningPotion and Color3.fromRGB(0,170,0) or Color3.fromRGB(180,0,0)
end)

dropBtn.Activated:Connect(dropAllWithEquip)

farmBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
	runningFarm = not runningFarm
	updateLanguage()
	farmBtn.BackgroundColor3 = runningFarm and Color3.fromRGB(0,170,0) or Color3.fromRGB(180,0,0)
	if runningFarm then notifyFarm() end
end)

-- ================= GRAVITY BUTTON ANIMADO =================
local clickSound = Instance.new("Sound")
clickSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://12222225" -- som de clique Roblox
clickSound.Volume = 1
clickSound.Parent = gravityBtn

local uiScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
uiScale.Scale = 1
uiScale.Parent = gravityBtn

local growTween = TweenService:Create(
	uiScale,
	TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
	{Scale = 1.15}
)

local shrinkTween = TweenService:Create(
	uiScale,
	TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
	{Scale = 1}
)

gravityBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
	clickSound:Play()
	growTween:Play()
	growTween.Completed:Wait()
	shrinkTween:Play()

	pcall(function()
		gravityEvent:FireServer()
	end)

	gravityBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,170,0)

	for i = 3, 1, -1 do
		gravityBtn.Text = texts[language].gravityDefault .. " (" .. i .. ")"
		task.wait(1)
	end

	gravityBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180,0,0)
	updateLanguage()
end)

-- ================= LANGUAGE BUTTON =================
langBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
	language = (language == "PT") and "EN" or "PT"
	updateLanguage()
end)
